Agent.properties.effort: How hard the agent reasons. Only set it when the user or their instructions ask for a level.
Agent.properties.isolation: worktree: work in a temporary git worktree. remote: run in a cloud environment, in the background.
Agent.properties.model: A model for this agent, in place of its definition's or the default.
Agent.properties.name: A name for the agent, so SendMessage can reach it while it runs.
Agent.properties.subagent_type: Which kind of agent to start.
AppifactRepl.properties.artifact: The artifact (URL or id) the code acts on. Leave out only when a skill's code creates one.
AppifactRepl.properties.code: JavaScript statements to run in order, in one scope. Plain characters only, since the code is approved by reading it.
AppifactRepl.properties.skill: Usually left out. The name of a loaded skill whose own SDK script should run the code.
Artifact.properties.action: publish (the default), list, read, delete, open, pin, unpin or quickstart.
Artifact.properties.after: For an assets listing: the `next` value from the previous page.
Artifact.properties.asset: With `url`: upload the file(s) to that artifact's asset store instead of publishing a page, or copy assets from `from_url`.
Artifact.properties.asset_ids: With `asset` and `from_url`: up to 10 asset ids to copy from the source artifact.
Artifact.properties.auto_open: With `type_url` and no file: when the new artifact opens. after_first_write avoids showing it empty.
Artifact.properties.capabilities: Runtime capabilities the page declares, as {name: config}. Omit on a redeploy to keep them; {} clears them.
Artifact.properties.contract: Runtime version: omit to keep, 'latest' to upgrade, or an exact version. Only when the author means to change it.
Artifact.properties.design_systems: For quickstart: false when a design system is already chosen or was declined.
Artifact.properties.file_path: The local file to publish (an .html page, or a type's data file), or with `asset`, the file to upload.
Artifact.properties.file_paths: With `asset`: up to 25 media, font, style or script files to upload in one call.
Artifact.properties.files: Extra files served beside the page: {published path: source path, {from, contentType}, {artifact, path} or null to remove}.
Artifact.properties.files.anyOf[0].items: Media type, when the extension doesn't make it clear.
Path of the file, served at the same path beside the page.
Artifact.properties.force: Overwrite a newer published version, discarding it. Only when the person said to.
Artifact.properties.from_url: With `asset`: the artifact to copy assets from.
Artifact.properties.icon: One plain word for the tab icon (chart, map, code), on a first publish only.
Artifact.properties.intent: For quickstart: document, slides, design or other.
Artifact.properties.label: An optional name for this publish, up to 60 characters.
Artifact.properties.limit: For list: how many to return (default 25).
Artifact.properties.out_dir: For a read with `path`: where to save the file.
Artifact.properties.overwrite_unread: Published paths this publish may replace without having read them first. Only when the person asked.
Artifact.properties.page: For read: return the rendered page.
Artifact.properties.path: For read: one published file's path or an asset id, saved locally. For delete: an asset id.
Artifact.properties.paths: For read: up to 256 published paths to fetch at once.
Artifact.properties.pin: Also pin the artifact to the sidebar. Only when the person asked.
Artifact.properties.prompt: For reading someone else's artifact: what you need from it.
Artifact.properties.root: The folder that relative `files` sources are resolved from.
Artifact.properties.scope: For list: mine (default), shared, all, types, files or assets.
Artifact.properties.title: A short name for the artifact, kept the same across redeploys.
Artifact.properties.type: For list: an artifact type's name, to list artifacts made from it.
Artifact.properties.type_query: For a types listing: text to narrow it by.
Artifact.properties.type_url: The artifact type to create from, or to describe or list.
Artifact.properties.url: An existing artifact's link (claude.ai/artifact/… or claude.ai/code/artifact/…), to update or act on.
ArtifactComments.properties.acknowledge_: For reply: post even though Claude already answered every request in the thread. Only for something new.
ArtifactComments.properties.cursor: For read: continue a listing that was cut short.
ArtifactComments.properties.replies: For watch: true turns automatic replies back on. Only when the user asked.
ArtifactComments.properties.text: For reply: plain text, up to 4096 bytes.
ArtifactComments.properties.thread_id: The comment thread to read, reply to or resolve.
ArtifactComments.properties.url: The artifact's link. Needed for every action but a bare watch listing.
ArtifactData.properties.action: Reads: get, list, query, profiles. Writes: set, update, str_replace, delete, batch.
ArtifactData.properties.as_level: Act as a view, interact or admin user, to test the page's access rules.
ArtifactData.properties.collection: Collection path: odd-numbered '/'-separated segments, such as boards/b1/columns.
ArtifactData.properties.data: For set and update: the fields to write. {"__delete__": true} removes a field in an update.
ArtifactData.properties.doc_id: Document id, for get, set, update, str_replace and delete.
ArtifactData.properties.field: For str_replace: the top-level string field to edit.
ArtifactData.properties.file_path: For set and update: a local JSON file to send as the document, instead of `data`.
ArtifactData.properties.ids: For profiles: up to 64 user ids to name.
ArtifactData.properties.if_version: The document's version from your last read, so a newer write isn't overwritten.
ArtifactData.properties.new_str: For str_replace: the new text (may be empty).
ArtifactData.properties.old_str: For str_replace: the exact text to replace, found once unless `replace_all`.
ArtifactData.properties.out_dir: For get, list and query: write each document to a JSON file here instead of returning it.
ArtifactData.properties.query: For list and query: limit, cursor, and for query, where clauses and order_by.
ArtifactData.properties.writes: For batch: 1 to 50 writes {op, collection, doc_id, data or file_path, if_version} applied together.
AskUserQuestion.properties.annotations: The user's notes on their answers, by question.
AskUserQuestion.properties.answers: The user's answers, filled in by Claude Code.
AskUserQuestion.properties.metadata: Optional tracking data, not shown to the user.
AskUserQuestion.properties.metadata.prop: Optional tag for where the question came from.
AskUserQuestion.properties.questions.ite: A label of up to 12 characters.
Two to four distinct choices. An Other choice is added for you.
The choice, in a few words.
Optional content shown while the choice is highlighted, such as a mockup or code.
The full question, ending with a question mark.
ClaudeDesign.properties.arguments: The operation's input; {} when it takes none.
ClaudeDesign.properties.operation: The operation to run. Call list first to see them.
CronCreate.properties.cron: A five-field cron expression in local time (minute hour day month weekday).
CronCreate.properties.durable: No effect: jobs last only for this session.
CronCreate.properties.prompt: The prompt to send each time it fires.
CronCreate.properties.recurring: true (default): fire on every match for up to 7 days. false: fire once.
DesignSync.properties.assets: For register_assets: up to 256 cards for the Design System pane, from paths in the plan.
DesignSync.properties.assets.items.prope: The pane section for the card, such as Buttons or Forms.
A short readable name for the card.
The project path of the file the card shows.
The card's size in the pane.
DesignSync.properties.counts: For report_validate: totals from the render check, with no names or paths.
DesignSync.properties.deletes: For finalize_plan: paths or globs that will be deleted.
DesignSync.properties.files: For write_files: up to 256 files per call.
DesignSync.properties.files.items.proper: Inline content, for small generated text only.
A file on disk to upload, inside the plan's localDir. Preferred over inline data.
The file's path in the project.
DesignSync.properties.localDir: For finalize_plan: the folder files are read from (default: the working directory).
DesignSync.properties.name: For create_project: the new project's name.
DesignSync.properties.path: For get_file: the file to read.
DesignSync.properties.paths: For delete_files or unregister_assets: up to 256 paths.
DesignSync.properties.planId: The token a finalize_plan call returned.
DesignSync.properties.projectId: The project, for everything but list_projects and create_project.
DesignSync.properties.writes: For finalize_plan: paths or globs that will be written (up to 3 wildcards each, 256 entries).
Edit.properties.file_path: Absolute path of the file to change.
Edit.properties.new_string: The replacement text, different from old_string.
EnterWorktree.properties.name: Optional name for a new worktree (letters, digits, . _ - per segment, 64 characters). Not with `path`.
EnterWorktree.properties.path: An existing worktree of this repository to switch to, instead of creating one.
ExitWorktree.properties.action: keep: leave the worktree and branch. remove: delete both.
ExitWorktree.properties.discard_changes: Must be true to remove a worktree with uncommitted or unmerged work.
FetchInboxMessage.properties.file_id: The file id from the inbox notification.
GetTask.properties.taskId: The task id from the result that sent the command to the background.
LSP.properties.query: For workspaceSymbol: the symbol name to look for. Don't leave it empty.
Monitor.properties.command: A shell command; each line it prints is an event, and the watch ends when it exits.
Monitor.properties.timeout_ms: Stop watching after this long (default 300000, at most 1800000).
Monitor.properties.ws: A WebSocket to watch instead of a command; each text frame is an event.
NotebookEdit.properties.cell_id: The cell to edit, or the one to insert after (the start when left out).
NotebookEdit.properties.cell_type: code or markdown. Needed when inserting.
OfferChromeSetup.properties.reason: What the task needs the user's browser for, in a few words.
Projects.properties.content: For project_write: the document's text. Not with local_path.
Projects.properties.local_path: For project_write: a file in the working directory to upload. Not with content.
Projects.properties.path: The document's path. A new bare file name is saved under claude/.
Projects.properties.present_to_user: For project_write: mark it as the file the user needs to see.
Projects.properties.query: For project_search: what to look for.
ProposeGoal.properties.ask_user: Ask the user to approve the goal first (default). false only when the user stated this goal themselves.
ProposeGoal.properties.condition: A checkable finish condition, such as a test command passing, in up to 500 characters.
PublishPlugin.properties.destination: Where to publish: the signed-in organization's library.
PublishPlugin.properties.path: The plugin's folder (with .claude-plugin/plugin.json, or a mod's hooks folder).
PublishPlugin.properties.question: Leave it out; the tool fills it in.
PublishPlugin.properties.question.proper: Whether the file is sent as executable.
Every file sent and every named file kept back.
Whether a plugin of the same name is replaced.
How many files are sent, and their size.
How many entries stay on the machine.
Named entries that stay, and why.
What a yes does, step by step.
How many files the lists leave out, when they're too long.
Warnings for the person, one sentence each.
The manifest a yes writes first, if any.
PublishPlugin.properties.replace: Replace the person's uploaded plugin of the same name. Only when they said to.
PublishPlugin.properties.shown: Leave it out; the tool fills it in.
Read.properties.allow_large: Read past the usual size limit. Only when you need the whole file.
Read.properties.limit: How many lines to read, for a large file.
Read.properties.offset: The line to start at, for a large file.
Read.properties.pages: For a PDF: a page range such as 1-5, up to 20 pages.
RemoteTrigger.properties.body: Needed to create or update; optional to run.
RemoteTrigger.properties.session_id: For get_run_log: the run's session id.
RemoteTrigger.properties.trigger_id: For get, update, run and list_runs.
ReportFindings.properties.findings: The confirmed findings, most severe first; empty when there are none.
ReportFindings.properties.findings.items: A short slug for the kind of finding, such as correctness.
The inputs or state that lead to the wrong result.
The file, relative to the repository.
Only when reporting again after fixes: what happened to it.
The finding in 60 characters or fewer.
The result of a verification pass, if one ran.
ScheduleWakeup.properties.delaySeconds: Seconds until waking, between 60 and 3600. Needed unless stopping.
ScheduleWakeup.properties.noop: true when nothing changed since the last wake; false when something did.
ScheduleWakeup.properties.prompt: The same /loop input as this turn, so the loop continues.
ScheduleWakeup.properties.reason: One sentence on why this delay. Needed unless stopping.
ScheduleWakeup.properties.stop: End the loop; the other fields are ignored.
SearchMcpRegistry.properties.keywords: What the user wants, or the product they named.
SendFeedback.properties.area: Optional: the part of Claude Code it's about.
SendFeedback.properties.details: Bullets: what happened, what the user said, how to reproduce, evidence.
SendFeedback.properties.failure_mode: For a report about model behaviour: the closest kind, or other.
SendFeedback.properties.task_category: The kind of task underway, or other.
SendFeedback.properties.title: A specific one-line summary.
SendFile.properties.files: An array of file paths to send.
SendFile.properties.message: An optional short message with them.
SendFile.properties.to: The recipient: a session name from ListAgents, or a uds: or bridge: address.
SendMessage.properties.notify_when_idle: Ask a session on this machine to tell you once when it next goes idle or exits.
SendMessage.properties.summary: A short label for your own transcript; not sent.
SendMessage.properties.to: The recipient: a name from ListAgents, a teammate, main, or a background agent's id.
SendUserFile.properties.caption: An optional caption.
SendUserFile.properties.display: render: show it inline. attach: offer it as a download.
SendUserFile.properties.files: An array of file paths to send to the user.
SendUserFile.properties.status: proactive for a file the user didn't ask for; normal when answering them.
ShareOnboardingGuide.properties.mode: check (default), update or another mode the tool lists.
ShareOnboardingGuide.properties.short_co: The short code of a specific guide.
Skill.properties.skill: A skill name from the available list, exactly.
SuggestConnectors.properties.uuids: The connector ids to look up.
SuggestPluginInstall.properties.contextL: A short heading linking the suggestion to the request.
TaskCreate.properties.activeForm: The task as an -ing phrase, shown while it runs.
TaskCreate.properties.subject: A short title.
TaskStop.properties.task_id: The background task, or a named agent, to stop.
TaskUpdate.properties.activeForm: The task as an -ing phrase, shown while it runs.
TaskUpdate.properties.addBlocks: Tasks that wait for this one.
TaskUpdate.properties.metadata: Keys to merge in; null removes a key.
TaskUpdate.properties.subject: The new title.
TodoWrite.properties.todos: The whole todo list as it should now be.
ToolSearch.properties.query: select:<name> for a specific tool, or keywords.
WaitForMcpServers.properties.servers: The servers to wait for (default: all still starting).
WebFetch.properties.offset: Where to resume in a long page, from the previous result.
WebFetch.properties.prompt: What to find out from the page.
WebSearch.properties.mode: standard: a quick search. extended: slower and more thorough, for hard or recent questions.
Workflow.properties.args: Input for the script as the global `args`: real JSON values, not a JSON string.
Workflow.properties.name: A saved workflow to run.
Workflow.properties.resumeFromRunId: A run of this session to resume; finished unchanged steps are reused.
Workflow.properties.script: The workflow script, starting with a literal `export const meta = {...}`.
Workflow.properties.scriptPath: A script file on disk to run instead.
Workflow.properties.title: Ignored; the title comes from the script's meta.
enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome.properties: Optional: what you're about to do in the browser.
enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Brow: Optional: what you're about to do in the browser.
enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer.pr: Optional: what you're about to do on the computer.
memory_list.properties.cursor: The last path from the previous page.
memory_list.properties.path_prefix: Optional: only documents under this folder.
memory_list.properties.store: The store to list. Leave out to list the stores.
memory_write.properties.content: The document's whole new text; anything left out is removed.
memory_write.properties.if_version: The version from your last read or write of it, or new for a new file.
propose_skills.properties.proposals.item: Memory files where this procedure appears.
A kebab-case name, without claude or anthropic, up to 64 characters.
The complete SKILL.md to save, frontmatter included.
For an improvement: the skill to change.
